propositions: Cancelled ACLI link delete commands (EOF on confirmation prompt, DEVNULL stdin) are miscounted as applied links, inflating links_applied to equal the computed count and producing silent divergence with error=None reported

The except CalledProcessError arm in _update_one_dispatch_links increments _links_applied without distinguishing actual idempotent race conditions (404/409/not-found) from deterministic cancellations, and has no diagnostic print
REBAR_RECONCILER_FAIL_SILENT_NOOP canary cannot detect this defect because it tests computed>0 and applied==0, and this arm artificially inflates applied to match computed

Missing --yes flag on both workitem link create and workitem link delete subcommands causes ACLI to prompt for confirmation, which reads EOF and exits with 'command cancelled' on every pass (bug 3256 precedent exists for workitem delete)

Idempotent race detection must match both stderr and stdout streams, not stderr alone, to avoid false alarms on concurrent removals where the 404/not-found marker lands on stdout (acli.py:739 precedent)

The fix adds _links_failed counter, narrows idempotent matching to documented markers across both streams, adds --yes to both link commands, and exposes links_failed in batch_outcome line for canary visibility
